column1: # The blocking gate's selections (dev/block.jl, `bash dev/gate.sh --block`; L194), measured by
# test/block_impact.jl from the lines of src/ each probe and each smoke group runs, cut into 40-line
# pieces of each top-level definition (225 probes run 947 pieces of src/, 21 cover them; 104 smoke
# groups run 1183, the core's 12 groups (58 cases, 29.2 s recorded) run 1040). `probes`: the probe
# core, a cover of every piece any probe runs; the gate adds the probes a change touches in
# test/probe_corpus.jl or test/probe_baseline.txt. `core`: the smoke core every landing runs, the
# cover by pieces per recorded second (test/smoke_times.tsv) up to 30 s; the first group pays for
# compiling the compiler. `<file><TAB><groups>`: a changed file's groups beyond the core, the cover
# (up to 25 s) of its pieces some group runs and the core does not; `-` when the core runs every
# piece any group runs (a directory row, ending in /, covers its files; the longest match wins). A
# changed file under src/ or ext/ with no row fails the gate: a batch that adds a file adds its row,
# re-recorded or, when unsure, naming more groups. Every probe and group still runs on every landed
# head (non-blocking: gate.yml on march/**). Re-record when src/ or the corpora move on.
